deviations.what: Inline audio player from the source was omitted
deviations.why: Vitrina has no audio/media field; the album showcase visual is kept as a static media card using d.gallery images.

deviations.what: Testimonials section ('What people say') was omitted
deviations.why: No real testimonial data exists in the Vitrina data contract; inventing quotes would violate the truth contract.

deviations.what: Newsletter section and embedded map were omitted
deviations.why: No newsletter backend or map field is supported; contact/location is handled by the shared FindUs component.

deviations.what: Unverifiable 'over a decade' claim and Tooplate credit note were omitted
deviations.why: The data contract has no such fields and fabricating credentials is forbidden.

deviations.what: Contact form was replaced by FindUs and SocialLinks
deviations.why: Vitrina has no form backend; shared components provide the supported contact/location/social pattern.

notes: Visual identity preserved: serif display headings with generous white space, two-column hero (text left / media card right), three 'How I can help' cards with icons, and portfolio cards with a type label above the title. Structural labels are in Greek; all business content comes from d.* fields.
